messages:
Tara V: Alerting finance team  I found ~52 invoices in NetSuite that show both a prorate adjustment and a separate reversal credit for the same subscription change, effectively canceling each other but leaving duplicate lines. Affected window: 2026-03-21 04:10-04:30 UTC.

Jamal K: That sounds like a retry/race. Any infra jobs running in that window?

Tara V: Yes, we had a transient NetSuite 500 around 04:14 which triggered the billing-worker retry logic. Also saw a Stripe invoice.finalized webhook for many of the same subscriptions at 04:15.

Ashwin: Quick hypothesis: billing-worker attempted to write a proration line to NS, got 500, retried and created the proration. In between, the webhook consumer processed invoice.finalized and kicked off a ledger cleanup that issued a reversal credit for what it thought was an unposted proration (it didn't find a record due to the earlier 500). When the retry completed, both proration and reversal existed.

Billing Bot: [alert] billing-worker retry storm detected 2026-03-21T04:17:02Z. See /logs/billing/2026-03-21/04/*.

Tara V: Paste of relevant lines:

```
2026-03-21T04:13:57Z ERROR billing-worker nsCreateLine 500 response body {"error":"DB Timeout"} retrying
2026-03-21T04:14:05Z INFO billing-worker nsCreateLine retry attempt=1 payload {"invoice":60022,"amount":-18.00,"memo":"prorate seats"} response id=ns_1488
2026-03-21T04:15:11Z INFO webhook-consumer handle invoice.finalized evt evt_fin_456 processing -> invoked ledger_cleanup for sub_231
2026-03-21T04:15:12Z INFO ledger_cleanup createAdjustment {"invoice":60022,"amount":18.00,"reason":"anticipated-prorate-miss","meta":{"orig_change":"change_999"}} response id=ns_1492
```

Jamal K: So net result invoice 60022 has two lines: -18.00 and +18.00 with different NS ids. That yields duplicate lines and confuses revenue reports.

Tara V: I ran a query to get scope:

```
SELECT invoice_num, COUNT(*) as dup_count, array_agg(id) as ns_ids, SUM(amount) as net
FROM ns_invoice_lines
WHERE memo ILIKE '%prorat%' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-21 04:10' AND '2026-03-21 04:30'
GROUP BY invoice_num
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
-- returns 52 rows
```

Ashwin: Root causes: 1) billing-worker retry path does not publish an event that signals line created until after final success, 2) ledger_cleanup checks for 'exists' by querying billing_events table which can lag behind due to eventual consistency of the write path. Combined leads ledger_cleanup to think proration was missing and emit a compensating credit.

Finance Ops: What's the remediation plan? We can't have invoices with canceling lines.

Tara V: Proposal: 1) generate CSV with invoice_num, customer_id, proration_line_id, reversal_line_id, amounts (I created sheet https://go/gdoc/ns-dup-prorate-2026-03-21) 2) Finance to approve voiding the reversal line (preferred) or doing a reversing journal where NS void not possible 3) implement a short-term guard in ledger_cleanup to check NS for a matching memo pattern before creating a compensating credit 4) patch billing-worker to emit a lightweight 'ns_line_created' event as soon as NS returns success, and make writes to billing_events strongly consistent for that path.

Billing Bot: [info] repair-dryrun produced 52 candidates, total amount $1,164. Artifact: /artifacts/2026-03-21/dup-prorate-repair-dryrun-2171234567.csv

Ashwin: I can produce the CSV and a dry-run void script that will only void reversal lines where the corresponding proration exists and net invoice total would restore to pre-run numeric total. Script will output a preview.

Finance Ops: Please include customer-impact column and flag >$75 deltas. We'll review and approve the void list. Also request a QC step: run a reconciliation job after voids that compares ledger totals to Stripe export.

Jamal K: Short-term defensive tasks: add a check in ledger_cleanup to query NS directly for memos with the same change_id pattern before creating adjustments, and add an alert for "canceling-lines > 3 in 30m".

Ashwin: Will push a hotfix to ledger_cleanup and add an integration test that simulates a billing-worker 500 + retry concurrent with webhook invoice.finalized. Filed infra#5528. Also scheduling a backfill to flag invoices with both proration and reversal within 10 minutes for manual review.

Tara V: Ops SRE paused automated retry escalation at 04:40 UTC to prevent further races. Will coordinate running voids once Finance signs off.

Billing Bot: [resolved] billing-worker alerts cleared at 2026-03-21T05:20:00Z.

Finance Ops: I'll review the CSV and post an approval in ~1 hour. Please don't run voids until I ack. Add a note in the billing runbook about race between NS retries and ledger_cleanup.

Ashwin: Acknowledged. I'll also add a telemetry metric for 'prorate-reversal-pairs' to catch regressions.

Tara V: Thanks everyone. We'll regroup post-remediation for a short postmortem and runbook updates. :white_check_mark:
